note: Questions whose answer is already known, asked two ways each. q1-q3 are hand-written; q4-q20 were written by an agent that read the repository and was forbidden from running the search -- otherwise it would have tuned the questions to what already works, which is the failure this file exists to avoid. The first draft scored 50% because `expect` listed usage.md and not usage_vn.md, so every Vietnamese phrasing was marked wrong for returning the correct section in the other language. The set was wrong, not the search. That is the harmless direction of that mistake; the dangerous one is a set that only asks what the system answers.
